subject: Runtime capacity: proposal to split senior hire into two mid-level hires (cost/time tradeoff)
thread:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 19 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Runtime capacity: proposal to split senior hire into two mid-level hires (cost/time tradeoff)

Team —

Background: I originally requested approval for 1x Senior Runtime Engineer (L6) focused on kernel-level optimizations and cross-platform KV-cache improvements. Recruiting has pushed back: market for L6 profile is tight, expected time-to-fill 5–7 months and comp at the top of the L6 band (~$330k OTE total comp) — plus hiring risk.

Proposal: To accelerate delivery and reduce near-term budget pressure, I propose we split the single L6 slot into either:
  - Option A: 2x Mid/Senior ICs (L4/L5 mix) hired in parallel (2 headcount items), OR
  - Option B: 1x L6 (original) + 1x 6-month contractor for implementation/triage

Rationale:
  - Time-to-impact: two L4/L5s can start delivering core batching + integration work in ~8–10 weeks; L6 estimated contact-to-impact ~20+ weeks even if we expedite.
  - Cost: fully loaded annual cost estimate (salary + benefits + equity run-rate):
      L6 (target): ~$330k OTE
      L5: ~$200k OTE each
      L4: ~$150k OTE each
  - Option A annual run-rate: approx $350k–$400k (2x mid mix) vs Option B annual run-rate: ~$330k + contractor (~$120k pro-rated) = ~$450k first year. Option A reduces first-year cash & gives redundancy.
  - Risks: splitting reduces single-person deep-systems experience (architecture tradeoffs). We mitigate with an L6-level tech mentor (0.1 FTE time) and stronger onboarding.

Attachments: hc-cost-model.xlsx (xlsx) — cost scenarios; offer-band-guidance.pdf (pdf) — suggested bands; org-chart.png — proposed reporting.

Ask: I need approval to convert 1 open L6 budget line into 2 headcount (preferably L4+L5) and permission to engage ContractorHub for a 12-week bridging contract if recruiting stalls. If we agree, I’ll slot reqs into Q3 hiring plan and send a hiring brief for each role.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Director, Runtime Engineering
Redwood Inference
